""" def render_html_page(visitor_message: str) -> str: """ Render an HTML page with the visitor's message safely embedded. Parameters ---------- visitor_message : str The content contributed by a user that will be inserted into the HTML template. Returns ------- str The resulting HTML string that includes the user’s content, properly escaped to prevent XSS. """ # Escape special HTML characters in the user-provided message. safe_content = html.escape(visitor_message, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
